name: Calculadora de Leasing de Carro
tagline: Calcule parcelas mensais e custo total do leasing
description: This tool helps users estimate their monthly car lease payments based on the vehicle price, down payment, interest rate, and lease term. Perfect for anyone considering leasing a vehicle and wanting to understand their payment structure.
metaTitle: Calculadora de Leasing de Carro – Calculadora de Leasing Automotivo
metaDescription: Insira preço do veículo, valor residual, taxa de juros e prazo para calcular a parcela mensal do leasing.
